references.title: Lesson editor with AI assistant
references.question: Q5
references.take: Teachable places an explicit AI assistant beside the rich text lesson editor, making guided generation available at the point of authoring.

references.title: AI course generator prompt
references.question: Q5
references.take: Kajabi exposes a focused Course generator dialog with a concrete topic field and Generate action, showing AI assistance can start from a single authoring prompt.

references.title: AI assistant content editing
references.question: Q5
references.take: Teachable's inline AI assistant supports editing selected lesson text, keeping suggestions adjacent to the authored content.

references.title: Generated course outline review
references.question: Q5
references.take: Kajabi shows generated modules, lessons, and descriptions in a review dialog with Apply and Discard, preserving author control over AI output.

references.title: Magic Write task prompt
references.question: Q5
references.take: Canva's Magic Write prompt asks the author to describe a writing task and offers preset generators such as Idea Brainstorm and Paragraph Generator.

references.title: AI generated writing with feedback
references.question: Q5
references.take: Canva presents generated copy with More like this and This but… feedback controls plus Insert, making refinement and acceptance explicit.

references.title: Contextual AI helper suggestions
references.question: Q5
references.take: Kajabi's contextual Ama helper offers task-specific suggestions alongside the editor, reducing the need for authors to formulate prompts from scratch.

references.title: School setup checklist
references.question: Q6
references.take: Teachable separates a general school checklist into brand, website, and earning steps, indicating setup tasks can remain progressive after entering the dashboard.

references.title: Creation wizard progress
references.question: Q6
references.take: Kajabi's creation wizard visibly sequences Course Outline, Landing Page, and Email Broadcast with completion indicators, making the setup order explicit.

references.title: Course setup guide
references.question: Q6
references.take: Teachable's course Setup guide puts curriculum creation first, then customization and pricing on one page, with Publish your course persistently visible.

references.title: AI outline starting point
references.question: Q6
references.take: Teachable starts curriculum generation from course title and description and labels other product types as alternate ways to get started, supporting a flexible entry point.

references.title: Course published confirmation
references.question: Q6
references.take: Teachable confirms launch in a modal with a sales page link and Done action, visibly separating publication from earlier editing steps.

references.title: Optional course appearance step
references.question: Q6
references.take: Kajabi's appearance step explicitly marks the thumbnail image optional and offers Back/Next, distinguishing optional polish from required progression.

references.title: Publish section flow
references.question: Q6
references.take: Teachable's observed three-step flow moves from curriculum with Publish controls to published states and a completion toast, placing publication after content editing.

references.title: Publish course flow
references.question: Q6
references.take: Teachable's course publication flow shows Setup guide before launch confirmation and then a Published course state, making publish a distinct final milestone.
